high_level_description: This image is a black-and-white photograph taken at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF). The setting appears to be an outdoor event during the evening, as indicated by the artificial lighting and the dark sky. In the foreground, there is a woman standing on what looks like a red carpet or a similar event space. She is wearing a form-fitting white dress with thin straps and a sweetheart neckline. Her hair is styled in loose waves, and she is accessorized with a necklace and bracelets. She is smiling and appears to be posing for the camera, holding up her phone to take a selfie.
